offer.text: Creepers keep blowing craters in my walls. Cull 3 of the hissing things and bring me peace and quiet.

accept.text: Strike fast and step back — you know how they end conversations.

decline.text: Boom. That'll be the wall again. Sure you won't help?

in_progress.text: How many creepers left out there?

ready.text: Three fewer walking bombs. My masonry thanks you.

complete.text: Quiet at last. Take this — you've earned every bit.
